items.title: Russell Brand was a 'sexual predator', prosecution alleges as rape trial begins
items.summary: The comedian and actor faces charges including rape and sexual assault from six female complainants who have never met each other, a court is told.

items.title: Trump posts video of UK tiger attack - as victim's family say online content causing 'severe distress'

items.title: One stolen every four minutes - inside the police battle against vehicle thieves
items.summary: Officers tell the BBC they are overstretched and struggling to keep up with sophisticated criminals.

items.title: Children killed in arson attack named - as family calls for culprit to 'own up'
items.summary: Two children who died in an arson attack at a home in Ireland have been named as Callum and Jayden, as their family and police urge anyone with information to come forward.
